props.alt: A black fortress on a rocky island, lava pouring down its cliffs into the sea
props.heading: Build Big with Bayzyl
props.body:
Bayzyl is a building toolkit for Minecraft. Type one command and a dome appears. Paint a forest with a brush. Copy a whole castle and stack ten more. Made a mess? Undo it.

Build Clubs, Camp Weeks and hosted servers for libraries, schools and youth organisations, all built on it. Bayzyl itself stays free and open source.
